0407: 
0408:     // A Mushaf page that fits entirely inside the viewport never produces enough
0409:     // scroll events to mark itself as "at bottom". Treat it as both scroll edges
0410:     // so an upward/downward page gesture always works. This applies regardless of
0411:     // whether the reader was opened from Surah, Juz, Pages, Search or Bookmark.
0412:     const contentFits = readerContentHeight.current <= readerViewportHeight.current + 12;
0413:     if (dy < 0 && (readerAtBottom.current || contentFits)) turnReaderPage(1);
0414:     else if (dy > 0 && (readerAtTop.current || contentFits)) turnReaderPage(-1);
0415:   };
